tabs.tab_title: How is it different from the free workshop?
tabs.tab_content: The free two-hour workshop walks you through the framework. BeFirst Live is a full day with our team in the room, so you finish your plan for all four stages before you leave.
No. You’ll learn the same framework we use with partners and leave with a plan you can run yourself.

tabs.tab_title: Can I bring someone from my team?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Owners and the person who handles marketing get the most out of it together.

tabs.tab_title: Is it right for my industry?
tabs.tab_content: The framework works for any local, service-based business: trades, health and wellness, professional services, retail and more. The examples are all from New Hampshire businesses.
